"dump type" isn't the best here.  Maybe "resourceParentName"?

dump type usually refers to the type of the dump (faultlog, ect)

Looking at `downloadEntryCallback` in log_services_utils.hpp, the parameter is called `downloadEntryType`. I haven't introduced the parameter but I assume it got copied over from `downloadDumpEntry` in log_services.hpp at some point. Maybe I just stick with `downloadEntryType` here, since this is the name used by the callback function and indicates the intent specific to downloading entries?
I have called it downloadEntryType now. No problem to change to your suggestion though, just let me know.
It looks good to me
